source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each Eternal's catalog text, parsed mechanics and ranked usage (eternal-usage.json) only; every number ground-checked, independent-judge rewrites re-applied from eternal-why-fixes.json

vesh.why: Extra damage over time whenever your abilities hit enemy heroes, growing stronger each minute: mid-lane mages and other ability-damage heroes, including some supports and off-laners, take it to make every spell hit harder.

minors.Lich: The common pick: healing from your spell damage that grows with level, for staying healthy in lane.
minors.Tithe of Death: Take it when you expect many kills and assists; each refills mana and permanently shortens your cooldowns.
minors.The Tenth Seal: For heroes whose ultimate is their main damage: from mid-game, a stronger ultimate that comes back sooner.
minors.Mind Rot: The common pick: the extra damage also takes a slice of the target's current health, best against healthy, tanky targets.
minors.Phylactery: For heroes who follow their ultimate with more spells: briefly faster cooldowns plus a shield based on your mana.
minors.Millennia: For long games on ultimate-heavy heroes: your ultimate damage keeps creeping up every minute.

aion.why: Mana regen each time you cast a spell, plus gold income from spell damage on enemy heroes: mid-lane mages and some ability-focused supports and off-laners take it to cast freely and buy items sooner.

minors.Philosopher: The common pick for steady gold income: free gold on a timer, coming faster with more ability haste.
minors.Sacrifice: For heroes who run dry in long trades: ability hits and hero kills refill missing mana.
minors.Bottomless Vial: When you take river buffs often: each one refills a potion charge and adds permanent magical power.
minors.Arcane Resonance: The common pick, best paired with Philosopher: more mana regen speeds up basic ability cooldowns and Philosopher's gold.
minors.Perfection: For mages who poke from a safe distance and rarely get hit: shorter cooldowns while near full health.
minors.Runic Focus: For heroes with a big mana pool who keep it full: more magical power the fuller your mana bar.

vermis.why: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals bonus damage based on their max health: carries who auto-attack, plus some junglers, take it to break down tanks and high-health fighters.

minors.Serration: The usual pick: the bonus hit also scales with missing health, so it finishes low targets faster.
minors.Crush: For heroes with stuns or roots: immobilizing a hero deals a big chunk of their max health.
minors.Mechadrive: For heroes whose secondary ability matters most: basic attacks keep shortening its cooldown.
minors.Melting Point: The usual pick: bonus damage against heavily armored targets, great when enemies stack physical armor.
minors.Breach: For heroes with a damaging ultimate: it strips a target's physical armor briefly so your team hits harder.
minors.Sub-Surface: Against teams with many area spells: you take less damage from area abilities.

thraex.why: The last hero you basic attacked takes more damage from you and deals less to you, growing with level: off-lane and jungle fighters, plus some carries, take it for long one-on-one fights. The King minor adds gold income.

minors.Alpha's Court: For solo laners and junglers who fight alone: bonus damage when no ally is nearby.
minors.Savage Strikes: The usual pick: extra damage on every hit that ramps against heroes and heals you.
minors.The King: For gold income: every basic attack on an enemy hero earns gold, great in lanes with constant trading.
minors.Ferocity: The usual pick: attack speed keeps climbing the longer you stay in a fight with heroes.
minors.Rallying Roar: For heroes whose ultimate starts fights: shorter ultimate cooldown and a speed boost for you and nearby allies.
minors.Golden Mane: Against single-target damage: you take less from attacks and abilities that are not area damage.

marrow.why: Heals you for part of the damage you deal to heroes, healing more the lower your health: off-lane and jungle fighters, plus some carries, take it to survive long fights. The Roses minor adds gold income from takedowns.

minors.Leech: Against lane opponents who rely on natural health regen: enemies near you regenerate much less.
minors.Blood Bank: For heroes who deal lots of damage quickly: heavy damage builds up extra lifesteal.
minors.Taste of Iron: For heroes with damage over time abilities like burns or bleeds: those hits boost your damage briefly.
minors.Roses: For gold income when kills come often: each takedown pays more bonus gold, and kills boost your healing.
minors.Jealousy: For fighters who keep swinging while low: you deal more damage as your health drops.
minors.The Maw: For auto-attack heroes who finish kills: basic attacks deal bonus true damage, which ignores armor, to low targets.

xyris.why: Bonus damage that keeps growing as you kill minions and monsters, up to a cap: carries who farm, plus some junglers and off-laners, take it to grow stronger the more they clear.

minors.Furor: For short fights: a burst of attack speed each time you start fighting heroes.
minors.Dominance: When you chain fights: each takedown heals you, more when you are low.
minors.Iron Will: The usual pick for critical strike carries: basic attacks heal you, more on critical strikes.
minors.Cull the Weak: For faster farming: more damage to minions and monsters, and mana back on each kill.
minors.Bone Collector: The usual pick for farming carries: after enough kills you permanently gain critical strike chance.
minors.Eviscerate: For burst heroes who open fights: bonus damage to targets near full health.

demiurge.why: Makes your items stronger, raising the stats they give and the damage of item effects: junglers, plus some carries and mid-laners, take it to get more out of every item they buy.

minors.Tri-Core: For auto-attack heroes: every hit deals bonus damage of a random type.
minors.Construct: The usual pick for steady value: more health and shorter cooldowns every level.
minors.Bio-Mechanical Fusion: For hybrid heroes who build magical power but deal physical damage: turns some magical power into physical power.
minors.Cursed Corrupted: For ability heroes whose items give critical chance they do not use: turns it into shorter cooldowns.
minors.Memory Leak: The usual pick for heroes who cast often: casts permanently raise max mana, and enough bonus mana adds movement speed.
minors.Bloatware: For long games: more damage and less damage taken for each item you own.

nihil.why: Damaging heroes builds Doom, which adds power and armor the longer a fight lasts, and levels and takedowns make it permanently stronger: off-lane and jungle fighters take it for long, drawn-out fights.

minors.Growing Threat: For late-game fighters: past a mid-game timer, permanent bonus damage and healing from all damage dealt.
minors.From the Abyss: The usual pick: steady health regen during hero fights or while hidden from enemies.
minors.Mana Siphon: For mana-hungry heroes: ability hits on enemy heroes steal mana.
minors.Adaptive Plating: The usual pick: taking damage grants matching armor, so you toughen up mid-fight.
minors.Inescapable: Against slippery heroes: nearby enemies who dash, leap or blink get slowed.
minors.Terror: For junglers and tower divers: much less damage from minions, monsters and towers.

exarch.why: Healing or shielding someone, yourself included, gives them faster attacks and bonus magic damage on hits: healing and shielding supports take it to make their carries hit harder.

minors.Illumination: When building mana regen items: you also gain that much health regen.
minors.Preservation: The usual pick: healing and shields you receive are stronger.
minors.Revelation: For supports who cast often: every ability cast shortens your basic ability cooldowns, so heals come back sooner.
minors.Fervour: The usual pick for supports who auto-attack in lane: hitting enemy heroes heals you and nearby allies.
minors.Omnipresent: For roaming supports: extra movement speed while out of combat.
minors.Delayed Fate: Against burst mages: part of ability damage you take is spread out over a few seconds.

krix.why: More max health that grows with level, plus a bigger body: tank supports, off-lane tanks and some junglers take it to soak damage. The Voracity minor adds small gold income from unit kills.

minors.Voracity: For gold income while farming: each unit kill heals you a little and gives gold.
minors.Regenerative Tissue: The usual pick: health regen after a short break from hero damage, so you stay in lane longer.
minors.Festering Wounds: Against healing-heavy teams: your damage over time and stuns or roots cut enemy healing.
minors.Cannibalism: The usual pick: every takedown permanently adds max health.
minors.Feeding Frenzy: For tanks who basic attack in fights: faster attacks for each enemy hero nearby.
minors.Predator: For junglers: killing camp leaders gives bonus damage and speed, lasting longer after epic monsters.

idrisil.why: Extra armor while healthy that turns into a big shield when your health drops low: tank supports, off-lane tanks and some junglers take it to survive burst damage.

minors.Cold Hearted: Against auto-attack carries: enemies who basic attack you get slowed.
minors.Mending: The usual pick: after taking hero damage, you heal part of your missing health.
minors.Frost Snap: For tanks with slows, stuns or roots: bonus damage to slowed or immobilized targets.
minors.Icy Touch: Against auto-attack carries and fighters: your basic attacks slow their attack speed.
minors.Glacier: The usual pick against magic damage: magical armor keeps growing as you earn gold.
minors.Diamond Tip: For tanks who want to deal damage: more armor penetration for each finished item.

lotus.why: Random small boosts to damage, cooldowns, speed or health on a timer and with every takedown: junglers, mid-laners, supports and carries take it as a flexible pick that keeps growing all game.

minors.Early Bloom: The most common pick: an extra level partway through the game, for heroes who spike with levels.
minors.Flawless: For ability heroes and supports: ability hits on enemy heroes heal you and nearby allies.
minors.Masterpiece: When you expect to chain kills: each kill gives stacking damage and speed for a short time.
minors.Immaculate: The most common pick: take less damage while near full health, good for backline heroes.
minors.Prima Donna: For heroes who avoid getting hit: more damage to heroes, but you take more damage too.
minors.Fragrance: For close-range magic or true damage heroes: more damage to enemy heroes near you.

weald.why: Hitting a low-health hero fires missiles of true damage that pass through walls: carries who auto-attack and some junglers take it to finish kills. The Forage minor adds gold income from minions and monsters.

minors.Forage: The usual pick for gold income: extra gold and experience from every minion and monster kill.
minors.Dryad’s Boon: For heroes who mix abilities with basic attacks: each hit shortens basic ability cooldowns.
minors.Natural Resistance: Against heavy stuns and roots: when very low, you break free and resist crowd control.
minors.Wind-Rider: The usual pick for heroes with dashes or stealth: faster attacks right after using them.
minors.Barkskin: Against auto-attackers in lane: enemies who basic attack you take damage back.
minors.Taproot: When you need healing in lane: basic attacks heal you, more with physical power.

knell.why: Your hits on heroes stack Rust, which shreds their armor and gives you part of it: off-laners, supports and some carries and junglers take it to make enemies easier for the whole team to damage.

minors.Frequency: For heroes who hit often: faster attacks and shorter cooldowns for each Rust stack on enemies.
minors.Patina: The usual pick: a shield after a break from damage, plus speed while it holds.
minors.Dampening: Against long-range poke: take less damage from enemies far away.
minors.Peal: For heroes whose ultimate starts fights: shorter ultimate cooldown, and casting it applies full Rust instantly.
minors.Fracture: The usual pick: more damage against targets with full Rust stacks.
minors.Resonant Repair: Against heavy crowd control: being stunned or rooted heals you and helps you shake it off.

pilow.why: Casting abilities weakens the damage of nearby enemy heroes, stacking, and makes you smaller: some off-laners, junglers and supports take it to blunt enemy damage in close fights.

minors.Bioluminescence: Against stealthy or slippery heroes: enemies you damage take extra damage and are revealed. Common partner for Neurotoxin.
minors.Harmonic Currents: The most common pick: each ability cast restores some missing health and mana.
minors.Diffusion: For big team fights: the weakening pulse reaches farther and lasts longer.
minors.Neurotoxin: The most common pick: the weakening also makes enemies take more damage per stack.
minors.Convection: For front-liners: extra armor for each active weakening stack on nearby enemy heroes.
minors.Lil Sucker: For chasing or sticking to targets: basic attacks steal movement speed.

satariel.why: Takedowns build Fearless stacks that trade max health for more power and attack speed, lost on death: some junglers, carries and mid-laners take it to grow stronger from early kills. The Demonic Bargain minor adds gold income.

minors.Demonic Bargain: The most common pick for gold income: a lump of extra gold at two set levels.
minors.Risen: For heroes who keep stacks alive: once you hold enough Fearless stacks, heal from all damage dealt.
minors.Hellfire Strikes: For auto-attack heroes: basic attacks deal bonus true damage that grows with level.
minors.Broken Wings: Against heavy slows: your movement speed cannot be changed, but speed boosts are lost too.
minors.Rite: For ability heroes: abilities cost some health, but permanently come back faster.
minors.Psychosis: The usual pick for divers locking one target: more damage to the closest hero, less to others.
